title: Luxury 6BR Mesa Estate | Pool & Water Slide
description:
Paradise Found is a luxury 6-bedroom, one-acre Mesa estate built for gathering, with a heated pool and water slide, pickleball and basketball court, putting green, movie theater room and a private guest casita. Sleeps large groups in resort-style comfort just minutes from the Salt River, Saguaro Lake and Arizona Athletic Grounds.

 The space 
Paradise Found
Where Luxury, Leisure, and Desert Beauty Converge
Welcome to Paradise Found, an exquisite one-acre estate that captures the essence of luxury living in the Arizona desert. Designed to delight the senses and inspire relaxation, this remarkable property offers a seamless blend of sophistication, comfort, and resort-style indulgence.
Whether you’re gathering with loved ones, entertaining friends, or escaping for a private retreat, this desert oasis invites you to experience breathtaking tranquility just minutes from the excitement of Arizona Athletic Grounds, Arizona’s premier sports and entertainment destination.

A Sanctuary of Space and Style
Every corner of this property has been thoughtfully curated to create a retreat that feels both expansive and intimate — a true home away from home with all the amenities of a five-star resort.
Main Residence
Spacious and elegantly appointed, the main home greets you with an open floor plan that flows effortlessly from room to room. Comfort meets sophistication with luxurious furnishings, curated artwork, and design elements that inspire serenity.
Enjoy movie nights in the private theater room, relax with a book in the bonus lounge, or simply unwind in one of the inviting living areas framed by natural light and refined décor.

Guest Casita
Perfect for extended family or friends, the private guest house features two large bedrooms with 4 queen over queen bunks in each and two full bathrooms, offering a luxurious space of its own. Thoughtful touches and high-end finishes ensure guests feel both pampered and at home.

Your Private Resort Awaits
Step into your own resort-style backyard, a desert paradise designed for indulgence, entertainment, and joy.
Sparkling heated pool & spa with cascading rock waterfall (Spa will only be heated to the temp of the pool heater if pool heater is purchased 10/15 - 4/15) Hot Tub available year round.
Thrilling rock water slide for endless fun
Kiddie pool for the little ones
Expansive lush green lawn surrounded by desert blooms
Built-in trampoline and playset for endless outdoor enjoyment
Professional pickleball court and putting green for recreation
Elegant lounge spaces for conversation, cocktails, or quiet reflection beneath Arizona’s vast desert sky
This is more than a backyard — it’s a wonderland for all ages, where every sunrise invites new adventures and every sunset celebrates serenity

Pool & Spa
Pool heating requires at least 7 days' notice before arrival.
SPLASH. This home is equipped with a gas-heated pool/spa, and pool/spa heating is optional. The cost for pool heat is $100 per day + tax 4/15-10/15. (Spa will only every be heated to the same temp as the pool if pool heat is purchased) This home has a hot tub that is included in the rental amount year-round. 

Room Configuration:
1. King + Sofa Bed (Primary)
2. King
3. King
4. Double, Twin, Twin
5. Queen/Queen , Queen/Queen, Queen/Queen, Queen/Queen Bunks
6. Queen/Queen, Queen, Queen, Queen/Queen, Queen/Queen Bunks
Additional Sofa Bed in the Family Living Area Beside the Casita

Embrace the Desert’s Natural Beauty
Your stay comes with the authentic charm of Arizona’s desert environment. You may encounter unique local wildlife — such as scorpions, lizards, or desert insects — all part of the natural landscape.
To ensure a pleasant experience:
Keep doors and windows closed when not in use.
Remain mindful outdoors, especially at dusk and dawn.
Our property is regularly serviced for pest control, though nature sometimes offers a brief hello.

Things to Know:

Maximum Occupancy: 20 guests
Minimum Age: 25years old
No Pets, No Smoking.

Your Paradise is Found. 
Every element of Paradise Found has been designed to inspire — the crisp desert air, the warmth of the sun dancing off the pool, the laughter echoing through the courtyard at sunset.
Whether you’re soaking in the spa, sharing an outdoor meal beneath the stars, or losing track of time in the beauty of the desert, you’ll discover that true luxury isn’t just found — it’s experienced.

Tax ID: 21201648! Book your stay today.

WHAT OUR GUESTS ARE SAYING
"This house was gorgeous and had everything and more that we needed! The host was very responsive and went above and beyond to give us a 5 star experience. Very clean and very well taken care of!"
— Verified 5-star guest review, July 2026

 Guest access 
Access to this home will be given within 7 days of your arrival. If you are due to arrive within 7 days and have not received via the Airbnb platform, please reach out

 Other things to note 
This home is perfect for: 
 • Families
 • Teams
 • Retreats
 • City Life but low-key vibes
 • Please be sure to watch small children, as it is not fully kid-proof
 • Space to spread out. 

Might not work for: 
Those with issues with steps, many Arizona homes have a drop-down living room and/or entryway step. Be sure to note this when booking to avoid accidents
